question: Can any trace of practice be discerned even in the unconditioned supreme scriptural meaning?
premises: The supreme scriptural meaning is unconditioned.
Even there, some trace of practice can be discerned.
This supports the claim that scripture arises through reflective manifestation.
inference: Therefore the account of scripture as reflective manifestation is fitting, even at the supreme level.
plain_english: This indeed would be fitting, for even in the unconditioned supreme meaning of scripture some trace of practice can be discerned.
